title: The City of Many-Columned Iram and Abdullah Son of Abi Kalabah
logline: A man looking for his lost camel walks into a magnificent empty city; at court a scholar explains it is Iram, built over centuries by proud King Shaddad, who was destroyed one day before he could enter it.
moral: Pride and power build splendour that their owner may never live to see.
tone: Wonder and mystery in the frame story, comic pomp for the king, a sudden hard stop at the cry, and a quiet, cool ending. Humour comes from Abdullah being out of his depth and from the king's vanity, never from the destruction.

beats.summary: Abdullah searches the Yemeni desert for a lost she-camel.
A great wall and tall palaces appear in empty land.
He calls for help; the city is completely empty.
He takes pearls and perfumes and tells the tale at home.
The Caliph summons him and does not believe him.
Abdullah produces the proof; the scholar is called.
Ka'b names it: Iram of the Columns, built by King Shaddad.
The legend: Shaddad reads of Paradise and wants a copy on earth.
Treasure is collected, even from the hands of the people.
The grey king hears it is ready and leaps for joy.
The great cry destroys the king and his procession.
The road to Iram vanished; finding it is rare.
A warning against pride and power.

sets.description: Planned desertRoad (AN-044/AN-095): scrolling travel strip, world 2400 x 1230, ground y 900, sand with three dune ridges (parallax 0.3, 0.55, 1), skyCycle sky, big sun. Options used here: tracks (camel hoof prints every 60 units along x 200..1500, pairs of small ovals), spring (blue pool 220 x 40 at x 1250 with three reeds and a palm), farCity (iramCity drawn at 0.22 scale on the horizon, y 880), roadFade 0..1 (a pale packed road band y 905..935 that sand ripples erase from right to left), villageEdge (two flat mud houses and a palm at x 150..450).

NEW iramCity, view 'front', world 1000 x 1230, ground y 900. Back to front: skyCycle; three palaces (x 90..300, 380..620, 700..910; walls top y 430, domes to y 300, 330, 300; yellow with red dot shade, blue arched windows); citadel (x 420..580, top y 180, one gold onion dome, field citadel 0..1 rises from behind the centre palace); wings (two arcaded pavilions x 20..180 and 820..980, top y 470, field wings 0..1 slide out sideways); nine columns (44 wide, 70 wide capitals, tops alternating y 360 and y 410, at x 60, 170, ... 940; field columns 0..9 fractional, each rises from the wall line with an overshoot); gardens (five palms and four bushes on the wall top line, field gardens 0..1 pop in turn); canals (two blue bands y 915..935 and y 960..985 that fill left to right, field canals 0..1); front wall (y 620..900, paper white with blue dots, crenels 40 wide, towers at x 0..90 and 910..1000 to y 560); gate (pointed arch x 430..570, top y 660, field gate 0..1 open, dark blue inside). Other fields: sand 0..1 (drift up to 140 high against the wall, covers the canals), glints (seeded star glints on domes and capitals), silhouette (flat one-tone version for the far view and for the plan scroll icon).

iramCity view 'street' (inside the gate), world 1000 x 1230, floor line y 900. Pale checker avenue narrowing to a vanishing band at y 560; two rows of four columns in three sizes (front pair 70 wide to y 150 at x 110 and 890, then 52 wide at x 250/750, 38 wide at x 350/650, 28 wide at x 420/580); a far palace with a dome at x 430..570, y 380..560; a dry fountain bowl (160 wide) at x 500, y 840; sky above. Pearls (pearlPile) lie in three heaps at x 300, 520, 700 on the floor; two perfume jars stand on the fountain rim. No people, no birds: stillness is the point.

Planned palaceHall (AN-084), full palace variant, 1000 x 1230: blue dotted back wall with three pointed arches, open door arch on the left (x 40..250, top y 480), dais x 560..900 top y 860, red runner carpet, checker floor, two lamps. The planned throne stands on the dais at x 730. Variant pal 'legend' for Shaddad's court: back wall red with black dots, yellow arches, gold runner, plus two hanging banners; drawn through the legendFrame effect.

props.description: Cloth sack, 90 wide x 110 tall when full (fill 0..1 changes the bulge), tied neck, open state showing 5 pearls on top. Carried over the shoulder (hand target at the neck) or set on the floor.
Single pearl, radius 14 (white disc, blue crescent shade, one white glint); pearlPile(n) is a seeded heap. A radius 60 version is used for the close shot with a picture inside (clip circle).
Small round flask, 40 wide x 60 tall, blue with a yellow stopper, three wavy scent lines above (seeded wobble), optional.
Planned throne (AN-084): seat 48 above its base, 150 wide, back 300 high with a pointed arch and finial.
Big book, 120 x 90 open (two pages with line marks, red cover edge), 60 x 90 closed; open 0..1 field. Held on both hands (handLW/handRW) or under the arm.

Planned treasureHoard / coinPile: four heaps that land in a row on the hall floor x 180..520, each about 110 wide: gold coins (yellow), silver bars (paper white with blue dots), rubies (red diamonds), pearls (pearlPile). Each has a grow 0..1 field.
Planned scroll, open 200 x 140, showing the iramCity silhouette as a line drawing; a red tick stamp can be added (done:true).
Planned crownProp (AN-046): gold three-point crown, 70 wide, with rot and a sink 0..1 field (clipped by a sand line) for the ending.
Pole 260 tall with a red swallow-tail flag 90 x 60; flag phase from K.noise so each differs; wind -1..1 flips its direction.
Speech-bubble map, 300 x 200: paper card, a dotted road from a house icon to the iramCity silhouette icon, a red X; erase 0..1 removes the dotted road from the city end and turns the X into a "?".

scenes.summary: At last the builders tell Shaddad, now grey, that his city is ready.

scenes.summary: One day from the gates, the legend says, a great cry destroys him and all with him. The king never enters his city.

subtitles.ar: خرج عبد الله بن أبي قلابة يبحث عن ناقة ضائعة في صحراء اليمن.|وبينما كان يتبع آثارها|لاح له سور عظيم وقصور مرتفعة وسط أرض خالية.|اقترب يظن أن أهل المدينة سيساعدونه، لكنه لم يجد أحدًا.
subtitles.en: Searching the Yemeni desert for a missing she-camel,|Abdullah bin Abi Kilabah|saw a vast walled city.|He approached hoping for help, but found it completely deserted.

subtitles.ar: جمع عبد الله ما استطاع حمله من اللآلئ والعطور الثمينة،|وعاد إلى بلاده يحكي ما رأى.|وصلت الأخبار إلى الخليفة معاوية، فأمر بإحضاره وسأله عن الموقع.|ظن الخليفة أن الوصف لا يصدق.
subtitles.en: Abdullah carried away pearls and fragrant treasures.|When his report reached Caliph Mu’awiyah,|he was summoned and questioned,|but the caliph doubted the extraordinary description.

subtitles.ar: أخرج عبد الله بعض ما حمله دليلًا،|فاستدعى معاوية عالمًا اسمه كعب الأحبار.|قال كعب إن المدينة هي إرم ذات العماد، وبناها الملك شداد.|ثم بدأ يروي سبب إنشاء تلك المدينة العجيبة.
subtitles.en: Abdullah produced objects he had brought back.|Mu’awiyah consulted Ka’b al-Ahbar,|who identified the place in the tale as Iram|and began recounting King Shaddad’s ambition.

subtitles.ar: كان شداد ملكًا واسع السلطان، وقرأ في الكتب وصف نعيم الجنة.|أراد أن يصنع في الدنيا مدينة تشبه ذلك الوصف،|فأمر حكامه بجمع الذهب والفضة والياقوت واللؤلؤ،|ولو أخذوها من أيدي الناس.
subtitles.en: Shaddad, a mighty king, had read descriptions of Paradise.|He ordered his rulers to collect precious metals and gems,|even taking them from people,|to build an earthly imitation.

subtitles.ar: بحث المهندسون عن أرض واسعة فيها ماء،|ثم أقاموا القصور والأعمدة والحدائق والأنهار.|وتقول الرواية إن العمل استغرق قرونًا، ثم أضيفت القلعة والأجنحة العظيمة.|أخيرًا أخبر البناؤون شدادًا أن مدينته صارت جاهزة.
subtitles.en: Engineers found a spacious, watered plain|and built magnificent palaces, columns, gardens, and canals.|In the legend, the vast undertaking|took centuries before completion.

subtitles.ar: جمع شداد وزراءه وحاشيته،|وخرج في موكب طويل ليرى ما أمر ببنائه.|لكن حين بقي يوم واحد على وصوله، تقول الحكاية إن صوتًا عظيمًا أهلكه ومن معه،|فلم يدخل الملك مدينته قط.
subtitles.en: Shaddad marched toward his completed city|with his court.|According to the legend, a terrible heavenly cry destroyed the procession|one day before it arrived.

subtitles.ar: أخبر كعب الخليفة أن الطريق إلى إرم اختفى بعد ذلك،|ولهذا ظل العثور عليها أمرًا نادرًا.|أما عبد الله فقد شاهد، في الرواية، بقايا مدينة لم يصل إليها صاحبها.|وتبقى القصة تحذيرًا أدبيًا من الغرور والسلطة.
subtitles.en: Ka’b said the road to Iram had vanished.|Abdullah’s discovery thus framed a cautionary legend:|a ruler spent a lifetime building splendor|he never lived to see.

new_assets.name: iramCity
new_assets.description: The many-columned city, two views in one module: 'front' (walls, gate, three palaces, nine columns, citadel, wings, gardens, canals; every part has a 0..1 build field, plus sand, glints and a flat silhouette mode) and 'street' (inside the gate: checker avenue between two rows of columns, far palace, dry fountain). Dimensions are in the sets entries iram and iramStreet. Reusable as any legendary, royal or ruined city (build fields at 1, sand to taste), and as an icon at small scale.
new_assets.implementation: One function iramCity(ctx, {view, palaces, columns, citadel, wings, gardens, canals, gate, sand, glints, silhouette, t}). Each part is a list of rectangles, arcs (domes via ctx.arc, pointed arches via two quadratic curves) and Ben-Day fills from halftone-pop; build fields translate a part up from behind the wall inside a clip rect at the wall top, with K.beat overshoot. Columns: a loop of 9, visible when columns > i, height scaled by clamp(columns - i). Sand: a filled sine-ridged polygon rising with the field, drawn last. Bake the static full-build version with bake() for S2, S17, S18 (sand drawn live on top).

new_assets.name: desertRoad
new_assets.description: Already planned (AN-044, AN-083, AN-084, AN-095). This film adds four small options: tracks, spring, roadFade and villageEdge (see set desert), and uses farCity with the iramCity silhouette.
new_assets.implementation: Three dune polygons from K.noise on fixed seeds with parallax factors; options are extra draw calls keyed by world x. Tracks reveal with a clip on x.

new_assets.name: palaceHall
new_assets.description: Already planned (AN-084) with the planned throne. This film adds only a palette variant pal:'legend' (red wall, yellow arches, gold runner, two banners) for Shaddad's court.
new_assets.implementation: Palette object passed to the planned set function; banners are the banner prop without a pole.

new_assets.name: camel
new_assets.description: Already planned (AN-044). Used only at s 0.4 inside thought clouds (S1, and the head only in S3). If the camel is not in the Library yet when this film is built, draw a simplified side silhouette (body oval 160 x 70, hump arc, neck, head, four legs) in sand colour.
new_assets.implementation: Planned camel function, or the simplified silhouette from 8 shapes.

new_assets.name: pearlSack + pearl + perfumeJar
new_assets.description: Treasure carried away: sack with fill 0..1 and open state, single pearl (r 14, r 26, r 60 with a picture inside), seeded pearlPile(n), perfume flask with scent lines. Reusable in any merchant, treasure or gift story.
new_assets.implementation: Sack: bezier bag shape scaled by fill, tied neck as two short lines. Pearl: white disc, blue crescent (arc clip), white glint dot; the r 60 version clips a callback picture inside the disc. pearlPile: K.rng seeded positions in a low triangle. Jar: circle + neck + stopper; scent lines are three sine strokes with phase from t.

new_assets.name: mapCard
new_assets.description: Map in a speech bubble (300 x 200) with house icon, dotted road, city icon, red X; erase 0..1 removes the road and turns X into "?". Reusable for any journey or lost-place story.
new_assets.implementation: Paper rounded rect inside the Library cloud/bubble; road is a polyline sampled into dots, drawn up to (1 - erase); sand ripples are short sine strokes moving along the erased part.

new_assets.name: skyCry
new_assets.description: A blast from the sky: five concentric white ring strokes (black outlined) expanding from a point at the top of the frame over 0.9 s, a 2-frame white flash at the peak, panel-only shake. Reusable for thunder, a divine voice, an explosion or a giant roar.
new_assets.implementation: Rings: ctx.arc with radius K.beat(t, t0 + i*0.08, 0.9) * 1400, line width tapering with radius, alpha falling. Flash: fill paper white for 2 frames. Shake: the template panel-only shake keyed on the cue.

new_assets.name: sandBlow
new_assets.description: Turns any drawn character into sand that blows away, with no body left: p 0..0.3 the figure is redrawn in one sand tone with dot shading (same idea as the planned statueTint), p 0.3..1 a wipe line travels from head to feet, the part above it replaced by seeded dust dots streaming sideways and fading. Reusable for vanishing, curses, time passing over ruins.
new_assets.implementation: Draw the character to an offscreen canvas (bake per frame at its size), tint with globalCompositeOperation source-atop in sand colour, draw it clipped below the wipe line; above the line emit K.rng seeded dots whose x offset grows with (p - their start), alpha falling. All a function of p, so frames stay pure functions of t.

new_assets.name: legendFrame
new_assets.description: The planned dream wash used at strength 0.35 as corners only (dotted blue vignette in the four corners, small ribbon THE LEGEND top left), so a long told story stays bright. Marks S9 to S15.
new_assets.implementation: Planned dream wash function with a corners-only mask (four radial dot gradients), ribbon via the style label.

new_assets.name: generations
new_assets.description: Time passing shown on a worker: age 0 to 1, tool handed to a child, the child scales up to an adult and continues; repeat. Reusable for any "years passed" beat with people.
new_assets.implementation: A helper generations(t, t0, period) returning {age, handover 0..1, index}; the scene draws the old figure with person age, the child with child:true and a scale blend 0.62 to 1, cross-faded with alpha over 6 frames.

new_assets.name: book, planScroll, banner, parasol, crown, treasure heaps, throne
new_assets.description: Small props listed under props; crown, treasure heaps, scroll and throne are already planned by other films (crownProp, coinPile/treasureHoard, scroll, throne) and should be the same functions.
new_assets.implementation: Each a small function of rectangles, arcs and dot fills; fields open, grow, sink, rot, wind as described in props.

owner_questions: The Caliph is shown as the generic Library caliph figure and labelled THE CALIPH; the name Mu'awiyah appears only in the subtitles (default: no name label on the figure). Confirm, or ask for him to be kept off screen (voice from behind a curtain).
Ka'b al-Ahbar is shown as an old scholar (physician preset, white beard) labelled THE SCHOLAR, not by name (default).
The destruction is softened: after the cry the king and his procession turn to sand and blow away, with no bodies; only the crown remains (default).
The lost she-camel is never found on screen, as in the script; she appears only in thought clouds (default: no added happy ending for the camel).

Added lettering beyond the script: THE CITY OF IRAM (title), HELLO?, PEOPLE: 0, WOW!, PROOF!, IRAM!, HERE!, COPY IT!, READY!, BOOOM!, DAYS LEFT: 1, SO CLOSE, and labels such as A GREAT WALL, CENTURIES PASS..., NEVER ENTERED, PRIDE, POWER (default: all kept).
Shaddad is shown grown grey by the time the city is ready, and three generations of builders pass the hammer on, to show "centuries" without stating a number (default: no year counter).
Paradise in Shaddad's thought cloud is shown only as golden palaces, a river and palms, with no figures (default).
Paragraph 2 is absent by design, so the film cuts from the empty city (P1) straight to gathering pearls (P3); the pearls are simply lying in the street (default: no added explanation).
implementation_notes: Start from Library/template; word cues via w(p, n) from timing.json. Every cue time in this plan is the listed word start on the final MP3.

The narration has only two pauses of 0.25 s or more (6.80-7.92 and 113.80-114.32), so there are just three effects: pop 7.3, chime 113.95, chime 170.7. The cry at 138.24 is carried by picture only (rings, flash, shake); do not add a sound there, it would cover the words.

Three worlds: desert (2400 wide strip), iram front / street (1000 x 1230 each), hall (1000 x 1230, two palettes). Bake each static set once with bake(); draw build fields, sand, skyCycle and glints live.
Set LIFE.t = t once per frame so every person blinks on its own seed; give every figure a gaze target with lookAt. Groups (governors, builders, court) always use stagger and different walk phases.
All walking uses walk(X, t) with a position function and footfalls for dust; nobody slides. The procession needs one position function with per-figure x offsets (90 to 110 apart) and phase offsets.

People: person with costume presets bedouin, caliph, physician (age 1), servant, villager, villageWoman, vizier, carpenter, lady, prince, merchant; Shaddad is caliph with pal {robe yellow, dot red, cape red, hc red, beard black}; his age goes 0 to 0.9 between S10 and S13. Seated figures use seat/sit as on the people sheet; kneel for the builder and for gathering pearls.
legendFrame (dream wash corners) is on from 70.92 to 144.78 and inside the pearl at 158.7; the two page-turn transitions (70.2 in, 144.78 out) bracket the legend. The single LATER... card is at 36.1.
The hall two-shots keep heads between y 560 and y 700 so nothing important drops near the caption panel; labels sit above heads and never over a face.

S15 timing is the heart of the film: banners flip 131.6, counter 133.4, sky darkens 136.2, heads turn up 136.9, rings 138.24, flash and shake 138.82, king blows away 139.64, court 140.52, crown settles by 141.8. Keep 2 frames of pure white only; no red.
Pearls are a thread: taken from the people (90.3), found in the street (25.1), shown as proof (50.7), and the window into the past (157.9). Use the same pearl drawing each time.
Call the style finish last every frame; panel-only shake for the cry.
warnings: Depicting the Caliph and a named early scholar may be sensitive for some viewers; see owner questions 1 and 2.
Almost no pauses in the narration: effects are limited to three and the climax has no sound effect.

Heavy new-asset load for one film: iramCity (L) plus the planned desertRoad, palaceHall, throne and camel, which do not exist in the Library yet. If they are still missing, build simple versions here to the stated dimensions.

The English subtitle is a shorter paraphrase of the Arabic (for example P6 English omits the citadel and the builders reporting), so the English chunks cannot line up phrase for phrase with the picture; chunks are split evenly by count.
The procession (up to 9 near figures plus a far row) is the most expensive frame; draw the far row as flat silhouettes.
